record.title: China closes remaining Kyinsankyawt Pangsai Muse freight gates during COVID surge
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.direction: Both-way trade; initially separately routed entry/exit
record.movement: Cargo crossings at remaining operating Muse gates
record.exceptions: Reopening trial used containers and driver substitution; other Muse gates stayed restricted.
record.enforcement: Contemporaneous closure and planned resumption reported; later state account confirms November 26 2021 reopening.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence; present status not inferred
record.official_rationale: COVID-19 cases in Myanmar and adjacent Chinese towns.
record.uncertainty: Kyinsankyawt's qualified reopening date is November 26, 2021. A January 2023 state article prints 2022 and a December 1, 2021 article prints September 26; contemporary November 25 closed-since-July reporting, actual November 27 cargo and later operational chronology favour November 2021. Pangsai remained closed in January 2022 and has no shared endpoint.
